description: This Java class implements a PaymentModule for PayPal Express Checkout, handling initiation, authorization, capture, refund, and transaction processes via PayPal's API, integrated within a larger sales or e-commerce system.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implementation of the PaymentModule interface for handling PayPal Express Checkout transactions within the sales system.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the configuration settings for the PayPal module, ensuring required API credentials are provided.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs authorization of a payment using PayPal, based on provided customer and transaction details.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Starts the PayPal Express Checkout process by preparing payment details, calling PayPal's SetExpressCheckout API, and returning a transaction object with the token.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Executes authorization and capture in a single step via PayPal API, returning a detailed transaction record.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund through PayPal, handling full or partial refunds based on transaction details and order info.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the detailed flow of executing a PayPal express checkout transaction, including obtaining checkout details and completing the payment.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Completes a capture of previously authorized PayPal payment, updating transaction records accordingly.
